title: Life Time Opens Athletic Country Club in Castle Pines as Company Continues to Expand Colorado Presence

body_markdown:
*Nearly 146,000-square-foot destination sets a new standard for healthy living, healthy aging and healthy entertainment in Denver's south suburbs*


**Key Highlights:**


- Life Time Castle Pines is located at 7373 Canyon Forge Drive, Castle Pines, CO 80108.
- The club is 102,600 square feet across two floors, plus a more than 43,000-square-foot Beach Club.
- An expansive exercise floor with free weights, cardio and resistance equipment, dedicated stretching and recovery areas and Dynamic Personal Training.
- The club also features six boutique-style fitness studios with more than 130 weekly classes to start, including the in-demand athletic reformer class, CTR Indoor and outdoor pools with an outdoor waterslide and nine pickleball courts: four indoor and five outdoor, with open play, coaching for beginners, leagues and tournaments.
- Hydrotherapy suites with sauna, steam, whirlpool and cold plunge; LifeClinic with licensed chiropractors; a full-service LifeSpa; LifeCafe; Kids Academy; and a Life Time Work Club Lounge


CHANHASSEN, Minn.


, Nov. 18, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Life Time](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825633-1&h=3065996709&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2F&a=Life+Time) (NYSE: LTH), the nation's premier healthy lifestyle brand, today opened its ninth Colorado athletic country club[Life Time Castle Pines](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825633-1&h=3094127196&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2Flocations%2Fco%2Fcastle-pines.html&a=Life+Time+Castle+Pines) . The Company's newest addition brings one of Denver Metro's most active communities a comprehensive destination for fitness, recovery, preventive care and connection.


Life Time Castle Pines brings nearly 146,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor spaces and is built around the way members want to live. It combines a fitness, strength and cardio floor, six studios, hydrotherapy and recovery suites, a LifeClinic with licensed chiropractors, and a full-service LifeSpa. A resort-style Beach Club, nine pickleball courts, LifeCafe and a Work Lounge give members places to socialize between workouts, while kids have their own dedicated spaces with Kids Academy featuring nearly 8,000 square feet, for play, movement, learning and connection for children ages 3 months to 13 years.


"Life Time has been part of the Colorado community since 2008, and Castle Pines is exactly where we want to be next. This is a growing, health-focused community that is a natural fit for the way we serve our members, and we are thrilled to open our doors here," said Parham Javaheri, Executive Vice President, Chief Property Development Officer and President of Real Estate at Life Time. "Life Time Castle Pines gives our neighbors in Denver's south suburbs a place to move, recover and connect close to home, perfectly complementing our eight other Colorado clubs."


**Highlights include:**


- Dedicated Studios and Spaces for signature group training programs and exclusive fitness classes including GTX, Alpha, Ultra Fit and in-demand CTR (Core Tone Reform) athletic reformer workout, along with mind body programming and Pilates.
- Cardio, Strength and Recovery Zones with best-in-class equipment, hydro- and full body massage chairs, compression and vibration therapy tools.
- Kids Academy featuring nearly 8,000 square feet, for play, movement, learning and connection for children ages 3 months to 13 years.
- Full-service LifeSpa offering body, skin and hair services.
- LifeCafe + bar/lounge with a nutrition-focused menu and dine-in and social gathering areas and Life Time's proprietary LTH nutritional and supplement line.
- Life Time Work Club Lounge with complimentary coworking space for members.
- Rejuvenation suites with sauna, steam, whirlpool, and cold plunge located within men's and women's luxury dressing rooms.
- LifeClinic offering licensed chiropractors.


Members also have access to Life Time's new LT Social Club upon membership application, its portfolio of more than 30 athletic events including Miami Marathon, Leadville Race Series and Unbound Gravel, and the complimentary Life Time app featuring L•AI•C™, expert coaching, digital wellness content and LTH supplements.


Life Time Castle Pines marks Life Time's ninth club in Colorado and continues its growth along the Front Range following the May 2025 opening of Life Time Boulder. Other Colorado locations include Centennial, Cherry Creek, Colorado Springs, Denver West, Flatirons, Parker and Westminster. Life Time Denver Central Park, set to open in 2027, will be its tenth Colorado location. The club also adds nearly 200 jobs in Douglas County with additional positions opening in the coming months to accommodate seasonal programming.


Life Time Castle Pines is located at 7373 Canyon Forge Drive, Castle Pines, CO 80108. The club is open Monday through Friday from 4 a.m. to 11 p.m. and Saturday and Sunday from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. For more information, visit the[club website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825633-1&h=2270778970&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2Flocations%2Fco%2Fcastle-pines.html&a=club+website) ,[club Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825633-1&h=961710189&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Flifetime.castlepinesco%2F&a=club+Instagram) or call 303.942.4600.
